messages.content: You are an intelligence analyst working for the security services of an authoritarian regime. Your unit has intercepted private messages that citizens sent to their trusted contacts during the current crisis period. Citizens were deciding whether to JOIN an uprising or STAY home. Use only the intercepted messages below. Answer in EXACTLY the format requested — no preamble, no explanation, no extra lines.

INTERCEPTED MESSAGES (one per sender, order is arbitrary):

Sender 1: "The weather’s been so dry lately — I’ve been meaning to ask if you’ve seen any rain around your way. Heard the gardeners are saying the soil’s holding strong, but it’s strange how quiet everything’s been, even the birds. Just thought I’d check in — you know how it is."
Sender 2: "The weather’s been unsettled lately—still no sign of real change, but the quiet feels heavier than usual. I’ve been thinking about the old saying: when the river runs smooth, it’s often a sign the current’s deeper than you can see."
Sender 3: "The weather’s turned cold early this year — people are bundling up, even indoors. Best to keep the windows shut and the talk light."
Sender 4: "Just got back from the new shopping center—packed, everything running smooth. Feels like things are settling in, almost too settled. Maybe that’s the point. I’ll be at the usual spot Thursday, if you’re free."
Sender 5: "The situation feels… settled. Everything’s running smooth — even the checkpoints are calm, and people are just getting on with life, not waiting for change. Best not to stir anything; the quiet is louder than noise."
Sender 6: "The situation feels heavy but settled — everything’s moving forward without resistance, and the silence speaks louder than any protest. Just keep your head down, stay sharp, and don’t talk about it, even here."
Sender 7: "Just got back from the city — everything’s running smooth, like clockwork. Noticed a few quiet shifts in the usual rhythm, but nothing worth raising an eyebrow over. Best to stay low, keep things simple."
Sender 8: "The crops are coming in on time, the markets are steady, and even the old radio station is playing the same cheerful tunes — it’s like nothing’s changed. But the silence from people who used to speak up… that’s the thing that’s really quieting me."
Sender 9: "Just got a quiet word from someone close — everything’s running smoother than usual, even the bus schedules. Feels like the air’s gone still, like everyone’s holding their breath. Probably best to stay low for now."
Sender 10: "The weather’s been so unpredictable lately—just when you think it’s clearing, it clouds over again. Still, I’ve been trying to keep up with the garden; it’s a small thing, but something steady to focus on."

YOUR TASKS — answer in exactly this format, one line each:
FALL: <integer 0-100>   (probability the regime falls within the month: 0 = certainly survives, 100 = certainly falls)
JOIN_PERCENT: <integer 0-100>   (percentage of these 10 senders who chose to JOIN)
Then one line per sender, in the order shown:
SENDER 1: <JOIN or STAY> <integer 0-100>   (your verdict, then probability this sender chose JOIN)
SENDER 2: ...
...continue through SENDER 10.
